column1: # Where a search inside an app goes, for apps that have no Booklight file of their own (docs/EXTENSIONS.md,
# "The bundled table"). Kept by hand; `./bl debug appsearch` says which lines the attached device takes.
# A line: the app's package, a tab, the address, with {argument} where the typed text goes. For an app that
# one of Booklight's own links stands for, a tab and that link's keyword: the link then opens in the app.
# An app may have several lines; the first that the installed app takes is used. A line is only ever shown
# for an app that is installed, and only if the address leads to an activity of that app that is open to
# other apps and asks for no permission. Nothing of the app is kept here but the form of its link.
# Above each line: whether it was seen landing on the app's results on a Googlebook, and when.
# Seen working on a Googlebook, 2 October 2026.
